latestVersion.changelog:
**Major update: Adds direct Chrome ("user" profile) browser control for OpenClaw 3.13+ and details new setup.**

- Added full support for OpenClaw versions >= v3.13 using direct Chrome attachment (profile: "user"); no relay extension needed.
- Provided step-by-step setup instructions for enabling Chrome remote debugging.
- Included profile auto-detection code for backward compatibility with older OpenClaw versions.
- Retained legacy Chrome relay extension guidance for users on older setups.
- Expanded troubleshooting and prerequisites sections for easier onboarding.
